'''Ji'Ni Sil''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Sil worked as the trader at the [[Jawa mountain fortress/Legends|Jawa Mountain Fortress]]. He owned a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] named [[C4-ZX]] as a translator.<ref name="SWG:BB" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Ji'Ni Sil was approached by a spacer who was looking for a body casing from a [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 unit]] that once belonged to [[Peggin Dulin]] and was later salvaged by Jawas. The droid was actually wanted by both [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Arlan Barrezz|Barrezz]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Carh'la Bastra|Bastra]]. Ji'Ni Sil informed the spacer that the droid casing was already sold to a [[robonium]] [[miner]]. Despite the miner was killed by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], the spacer finally managed to retrieve the casing.<ref name="SWG:BB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ji'Ni Sil was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ji'Ni Sil was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
